searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he generation 7 — chesed brainstorm the awtsmoos renews every public road while mutable worlds appear and flee; awtsmoos.com should reveal truthful seo on every trusted domain without letting forged hosts decree. infinite possibility field 1. record which exact sitemap advertised every crawled url. 2. when an advertised page returns 404, refetch that exact source sitemap. 3. if the url disappeared, classify it as crawl time churn rather than a broken indexed road. 4. if the url remains advertised, keep the 404 as a hard release failure. 5. report churn separately so mutable data remains visible rather than silently ignored. 6. keep transport retry semantics separate from http verdicts. 7. preserve full sitemap provenance across nested sitemap indexes. 8. add deterministic fixtures for disappearing versus persistent 404 urls. 9. make tenant html seo trust a server side host policy instead of arbitrary host headers. 10. trust awtsmoos owned domains by suffix and exact root. 11. trust localhost/127.x only for local development and verification. 12. trust custom domains only when explicitly configured by deployment/hosting authority. 13. never accept wildcard custom host configuration from a request. 14. strip/normalize host ports safely so custom domain canonical identity is stable. 15. unknown host responses must not emit forged canonical, opengraph, twitter, or json ld urls. 16. prefer noindex for unknown unregistered hosts so mirrors cannot accidentally create duplicate indexed worlds. 17. preserve authored metadata on trusted creator sites. 18. fill only missing title/description/canonical/robots/social/schema vessels. 19. keep private/edit/admin/query pages noindex. 20. keep registered awtsmoos pages on their fixed canonical metadata regardless of request host. 21. add security regressions proving attacker.example cannot mint canonical authority. 22. add custom domain regressions proving an explicitly trusted example domain gets its own https canonical. 23. add awtsmoos subdomain regressions. 24. add localhost with port regressions for runtime verification. 25. keep dns/tls ownership outside html seo; never pretend a domain is connected merely because a host header arrived. 26. document the hosting contract: custom dns/tls adapter binds the domain, then the seo allowlist activates host aware metadata automatically. 27. later expose this host binding through a durable project publication registry rather than an environment string. 28. later generate tenant specific robots/sitemaps from the project publication graph once a public domain adapter exists. 29. keep all new modules under 120 lines, tab indented, readable, and split by responsibility. 30. rerun full seo, heichel, route, manifest, runtime, public crawl, guarded release, exact sha activation, and public verification.

Risks and restraints Do not resurrect comments that no longer exist or no
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he generation 7 — gevurah risk map the awtsmoos gives every generous light a boundary where truth may stay; awtsmoos.com must distinguish living mutation from broken promise, and trusted domain from host header play. risks and restraints do not resurrect comments that no longer exist or no longer qualify as public. do not suppress a persistent sitemap advertised 404. do not suppress non 404 server failures or transport failures through churn logic. do not revalidate against the root sitemap when the exact child sitemap provenance is known. do not let arbitrary host values become canonical authority. do not infer dns ownership from dns syntax alone. do not implement fake tls/dns automation where no publication adapter exists. do not hard code one user's custom domain. do not overwrite authored canonical/meta/schema on registered awtsmoos pages. do not index private/admin/edit/query surfaces. do not mutate the shared dirty canonical checkout or old dirty integration worktree. do not deploy from a worktree whose base is stale or whose path set overlaps concurrent upstream work. selected architecture crawler provenance is carried by sitemapwalker; a dedicated revalidation module owns exact source sitemap membership; crawl owns row/error classification only. tenant domain trust is carried by a dedicated host policy module. publichtmlseorequest consumes that policy; publichtmlseo treats an untrusted host as noindex only and enriches only trusted tenant origins. custom dns activation remains an infrastructure responsibility. awtsmoos public custom hosts is the immediate server side bridge until the project hosting publication adapter gains a durable domain registry.
